title: 第十八章 乌云盖顶
novel_title: 凡人修仙：谁说修仙必须灵力
content_zh:
天快亮的时候，三人终于翻过了落雁坡最后一道山脊。远处山脚下隐约有一片灯火，稀稀疏疏的，不像镇子，倒像是几十户人家聚在一起。

    “到了？”欧阳琦问。

    沈君壁盯着那片灯火看了很久，摇了摇头：“不对。小坊市晚上不点灯，点灯招人。散修最怕的就是被人知道自己在哪。”

    侯紫一屁股坐在地上，把怀里那些东西一样一样往外掏：“管它是不是，先歇会儿。这趟亏大了，沈别鹤他们三个穷鬼身上就摸了几颗灵石，连个储物袋都没有。”

    “他们有就不正常了。”沈君壁淡淡地说，“宗门弟子人手一个储物袋，那是宗门给炼气期弟子的标配。散修？炼气中期以下，十个有八个买不起。沈别鹤抢了三年，攒下的灵石还不够买半个储物袋的。”

    欧阳琦忽然开口：“听起来，跟醉月楼差不多。头牌住二楼，烧火丫头一个月攒不下一吊钱。”

    侯紫看了看自己面前那堆东西，忽然觉得有点扎眼。他一个市井混混，摸了两具尸体，就拿到了散修三年都抢不到的东西。他把那两张黄纸符从储物袋里掏出来，正要问这是什么东西。

    沈君壁的眼神忽然变了。

    “这是……”他接过符纸，手指在符文的笔画上轻轻摩挲。动作和摩挲祖传玉佩时一模一样，但这次是在辨认，辨认那些他从小就看着父亲一笔一划描绘的纹路。

    “我认识。”他说，声音压得很低，“这张是敛息符，这张是轻身符。沈家祖传的手艺。”

    “凡人也能画？”

    “不是所有凡人都能画。”沈君壁把符纸放在膝盖上，手指还停在符文上，“沈家三代人，只有直系血脉从小练。三岁开始认符文，五岁开始描红，七岁画出第一张完整的辟邪符。我祖父练了六十年，我父亲练了四十年，我练了十五年。”他顿了顿，“沈别鹤不会。他是旁系，没资格学。”

    侯紫沉默了一会儿。他没问沈君壁为什么之前不说。三年前灭门之后，这门手艺就是沈君壁身上最后一根骨头。之前沈别鹤突然迅速制住他，想必也是防着他用符纸。

    他把符纸推过去。

    “符纸这东西，我不会用。在岳州城赌场门口，账房先生教过我，什么东西该交给什么人。打架是我的事，符纸是你的。”

    沈君壁看着侯紫，没说话。
content_en:
At dawn, the three of them finally crossed the last ridge of Luoyanpo.There was a faint light at the foot of the mountain in the distance. It was sparse and sparse. It didn't look like a town, but more like dozens of families gathered together.

"Are we here?" Ouyang Qi asked.

Shen Junbi stared at the lights for a long time and shook his head: "That's not right. Xiaofang City doesn't light up the lights at night, it lights up to recruit people. What casual cultivators fear most is having people know where they are."

Hou Zi sat down on the ground and took out all the things in his arms: "Whatever it is, let's rest for a while. This trip was a big loss. Shen Biehe and the other three poor guys only touched a few spirit stones on their bodies, and they didn't even have a storage bag."

"It's abnormal for them to have it." Shen Junbi said lightly, "Every sect disciple has a storage bag. That is the sect's standard equipment for disciples in the Qi refining stage. Casual cultivators? Below the middle stage of Qi refining, eight out of ten cannot afford it. Shen Biehe has been snatching it for three years, but the spiritual stones he saved are not enough to buy half a storage bag."

Ouyang Qi suddenly said: "It sounds similar to Zuiyue Tower. The top one lives on the second floor, and the fire girl can't save a drop of money in a month."

Hou Zi looked at the pile of things in front of him and suddenly felt a little dazzling.He, a market gangster, touched two corpses and got something that even the casual cultivators couldn't grab for three years.He took out the two yellow paper charms from his storage bag and was about to ask what they were.

Shen Junbi's eyes suddenly changed.

"This is..." He took the rune paper and gently rubbed his fingers on the strokes of the rune.The movements were exactly the same as when he was rubbing the ancestral jade pendant, but this time he was identifying the lines that he had watched his father draw stroke by stroke since he was a child.

"I know them." He said, his voice was very low, "This one is the breath gathering charm, and this one is the light body charm. The craftsmanship inherited from the Shen family."

"Can mortals draw?"

"Not all mortals can draw." Shen Junbi put the talisman paper on his knees, his fingers still resting on the runes. "Of the three generations of the Shen family, only the direct bloodline has practiced since childhood. He began to recognize runes at the age of three, trace red at the age of five, and drew the first complete evil-proof talisman at the age of seven. My grandfather has been practicing for 60 years, my father has been practicing for 40 years, and I have been practicing for 15 years." He paused, "Shen Biehe doesn't know it. He is a collateral line and is not qualified to learn."

Hou Zi was silent for a while.He didn't ask Shen Junbi why he didn't tell him before.After the family was wiped out three years ago, this craft was the last bone in Shen Junbi's body.Shen Biehe suddenly and quickly restrained him before, presumably to prevent him from using the talisman.

He pushed the talisman over.

"I don't know how to use the talisman paper. At the entrance of Yuezhou City Casino, Mr. Accountant taught me what should be given to whom. Fighting is my business, and the talisman paper is yours."

Shen Junbi looked at Hou Zi and said nothing.
